prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high, except for the pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.
Redesigning the grid view pet companion was helpful.
Adding new screens (validation stage or personality selection) performed worse.
Reordering the onboarding flow to narrative-first performed worse, while deferring sign-in showed no clear effect.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, notifications, status banners, wait info, or copy changes showed no clear effect.
Simplifying the path choice layout showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -14.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +17.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -4.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Two Column Path Choice Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen using a clear two-column layout side-by-side comparing predefined companions versus custom pet creation. (why: The choose_path step has a conversion of 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation when evaluating options.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Card Layout Sign-In Presentation: Redesign the sign-in screen into a clean card layout with prominent authentication methods and clear sync messaging. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets when signing in again.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Pick Friend Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using an interactive carousel layout to allow smooth horizontal browsing through pet models. (why: Adoption step conversion is 73.1% and takes a median 89s and mean 1017s, indicating users take a long time to select a pet.)
3: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Generation Wait View: Redesign the waiting screen into a focused stage layout centered around the pet companion creation status. (why: The waiting step duration is high (median 201s, mean 2336s), requiring a focused stage presentation to keep user engagement high.)
4: [finish, redesign] Split Layout Finish Welcome Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen using a split layout displaying pet activation confirmation on one side and controls summary on the other. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails from users unclear on how to control or hide their pet.)
5: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Compact Layout: Reformat the photo upload screen into a compact layout with direct upload actions and clear photo guidelines. (why: Custom photo generation fails or looks wrong for several users (3 support tickets) and adoption mean duration is very high (1017s).)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Headline Direct Copy: Update the story screen headline and body text to concisely explain the desktop companion concept before choice selection. (why: First step dropoff is 23.8% and users spend an average of 514s on choose_path, indicating initial value proposition needs clarity.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Clear Re-authentication Copy: Update sign_in headline and body copy to explicitly instruct existing users on how to recover existing pets during sign-in. (why: Support mail logged 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
8: [finish, layout] Home Intro Checklist Layout: Change home_intro screen to a checklist layout highlighting key shortcuts and interaction toggles. (why: Support mailbox received multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with pets after finishing setup.)

Supported strongly by support emails and funnel dropoff; full UI redesign requires release.

Low cost copy update aimed at dropoff, but copy changes typically show minor impact.
Very strong evidence from 8 support complaints; low cost copy tweak matched by prior sign_in copy test (+4.4%).
